reached_sql:
WITH dim_pairs AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk, dt.d_date_sk, dt.d_year, i.i_brand_id, i.i_brand
    FROM item i
    JOIN date_dim dt ON TRUE
    WHERE i.i_manufact_id = 816
      AND dt.d_moy = 11
)
SELECT dp.d_year,
       dp.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
       dp.i_brand AS brand,
       SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN dim_pairs dp
  ON ss.ss_item_sk = dp.i_item_sk
 AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dp.d_date_sk
GROUP BY dp.d_year, dp.i_brand_id, dp.i_brand
ORDER BY dp.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
